# NullBreach

NullBreach is an open-source AppSec portfolio project by Valentina Ramírez, also known as wavival. It helps developers reason about secure development through AI-assisted chat, code analysis, and OWASP-oriented guidance.

## Canonical resources

- Public site: https://www.wavival.dev/nullbreach
- English site: https://www.wavival.dev/nullbreach/en
- Repository: https://github.com/wavival/nullbreach
- Case study: https://github.com/wavival/nullbreach/blob/dev/docs/case-study.md
- API documentation: https://github.com/wavival/nullbreach/blob/dev/docs/api.md
- Swagger UI: https://www.wavival.dev/nullbreach/swagger
- OpenAPI document: https://www.wavival.dev/nullbreach/api/openapi

## Scope

NullBreach is a portfolio project, not a commercial security service. Its generated guidance is not a substitute for professional security review, penetration testing, or dedicated security tooling.

- English: https://www.wavival.dev/nullbreach/en
